description: Flat metadata schema for record-level CLIP-seq experiments profiling RNA-binding protein interactions in vertebrate embryonic development.

record_id.descr: Unique identifier for the metadata record or sample/library within the dataset.

project_id.descr: Identifier linking the record to a broader project or study.

species_common_name.descr: Common name of the vertebrate species studied, e.g., zebrafish, mouse, Xenopus.

species_scientific_name.descr: Scientific name of the vertebrate species, e.g., Danio rerio, Mus musculus, Xenopus laevis.

developmental_stage.descr: Developmental stage of the embryo/sample, using a standard staging system when possible; e.g., hours post-fertilization, somite stage, Carnegie stage.

developmental_stage_system.descr: Staging framework used to define the developmental stage, e.g., hpf, somite stage, HH stage, Carnegie stage.

embryo_age_value.descr: Numeric developmental age value associated with the sample, if applicable.

embryo_age_unit.descr: Unit for developmental age, e.g., hpf, dpf, days post coitum.

sample_tissue_or_region.descr: Embryonic tissue, organ, cell type, or region sampled for CLIP-seq.

anatomical_context.descr: Broader anatomical or embryological context, e.g., whole embryo, neural tube, mesoderm, germ layer.

rna_binding_protein_name.descr: Name of the RNA-binding protein investigated, using standard gene/protein nomenclature when possible.

rna_binding_protein_id.descr: Standard identifier for the RBP, such as UniProt ID, Ensembl gene ID, or NCBI Gene ID.

protein_species_origin.descr: Species origin of the protein target if different from the sample species, e.g., ortholog or transgene source.

antibody_name.descr: Name or catalog identifier of the antibody used for immunoprecipitation.

antibody_vendor.descr: Manufacturer or supplier of the antibody.

antibody_catalog_number.descr: Vendor catalog number for the antibody.

crosslinking_method.descr: Crosslinking strategy used prior to immunoprecipitation, e.g., UV 254 nm, UV 365 nm, formaldehyde.

crosslinking_energy_or_dose.descr: Crosslinking exposure level, if quantified, e.g., mJ/cm^2, J/cm^2, or laser dose.

crosslinking_unit.descr: Unit for crosslinking_energy_or_dose, e.g., mJ/cm^2, J/cm^2.

clip_protocol_type.descr: Type of CLIP assay used, e.g., HITS-CLIP, iCLIP, eCLIP, PAR-CLIP, CRAC.

interaction_detection_method.descr: Primary method used to detect protein-RNA interactions; typically CLIP-seq or a specific CLIP variant.

library_preparation_protocol.descr: Library preparation protocol or kit used for sequencing library construction.

rna_fragmentation_method.descr: Method used to fragment RNA, if applicable, e.g., partial RNase digestion, sonication, none.

rnase_type.descr: RNase used during CLIP workflow, if any, e.g., RNase I, RNase T1, micrococcal nuclease.

rnase_concentration.descr: Concentration of RNase used during digestion, if quantified.

rnase_concentration_unit.descr: Unit for RNase concentration, e.g., ng/uL, U/mL.

immunoprecipitation_condition.descr: Key immunoprecipitation conditions, including buffer or temperature, as a concise structured text field.

input_control_available.descr: Whether an input or no-antibody control library is available for this record.

input_control_record_id.descr: Identifier of the matched input or control sample, if available.

biological_replicate_number.descr: Biological replicate number for the sample, starting at 1.

technical_replicate_number.descr: Technical replicate number for the sample, starting at 1.

sample_individual_id.descr: Identifier for the biological individual embryo or pool from which the sample was derived.

pooling_strategy.descr: Description of whether samples were pooled, and if so, how pooling was performed.

sample_amount_rna.descr: Amount of RNA input used for library preparation, if known.

sample_amount_rna_unit.descr: Unit for sample_amount_rna, e.g., ng, ug.

sequencing_platform.descr: Sequencing instrument/platform used, e.g., Illumina NovaSeq, HiSeq, NextSeq.

sequencing_depth_million_reads.descr: Total sequencing depth for the record, in millions of reads.

barcode_or_umi_used.descr: Whether barcodes or unique molecular identifiers were used.

umi_length_nt.descr: Length of the unique molecular identifier in nucleotides, if used.

adapter_sequences.descr: Adapter sequence information or adapter kit name used in library construction.

reference_genome.descr: Reference genome assembly used for read alignment, e.g., GRCm39, danRer11.

reference_annotation_version.descr: Transcript annotation version used for mapping and peak calling, e.g., GENCODE vM32.

alignment_software.descr: Software used for sequence alignment, e.g., STAR, Bowtie2, HISAT2.

alignment_parameters.descr: Key alignment parameters or command options relevant for reproducibility.

peak_calling_or_binding_site_method.descr: Method/software used to identify RBP binding sites or peaks, if applicable.

peak_calling_parameters.descr: Key peak-calling parameters or thresholds used.

filtering_criteria.descr: Quality filtering criteria applied to reads or peaks, e.g., MAPQ threshold, duplicate removal.

qc_metrics_summary.descr: Concise summary of important QC metrics for the record, e.g., mapping rate, duplicate rate, library complexity.

data_file_name.descr: Primary raw or processed data file name associated with this record.

data_file_format.descr: File format of the associated data file, e.g., FASTQ, BAM, BED, bigWig.

data_file_checksum.descr: Checksum for the associated file, e.g., MD5 or SHA256, to support integrity verification.

repository_accession.descr: Accession identifier in a public repository, if deposited, e.g., GEO, SRA, ENA accession.

experiment_date.descr: Date on which the experiment or sample processing was performed, if available.

publication_doi.descr: DOI of the publication describing the experiment, if available.

notes.descr: Additional free-text notes relevant to the sample, protocol deviations, or biological interpretation.
